info.submission: Fixed the ValueError in cell 2 by adding .convert('RGB') when loading images to ensure all images have consistent 3 channels (RGB). The error was caused by 2 images in the dataset having 4 channels (RGBA) while the remaining 114 had 3 channels (RGB), causing numpy.reshape to fail with an inhomogeneous shape error. The fix ensures all images are converted to RGB before being added to the training data array.
